post.description: Create multiple ponds for a farm. Request: farmId, array of names. New ponds have status maintenance. Requires client-admin role or above.

Upsert farms and ponds from a parsed template. Missing farms are created. Missing ponds are created with status maintenance. Existing ponds get their area updated when an area is provided. No deletes. Requires client-admin role or above.
Compute live cost/weight totals for the fill (add stock) form. Pure math, no validation against pond state. Used for live form updates as the user types.
Compute live cost/weight totals for the move (transfer) form. Pure math, no validation against pond state.
Compute live revenue/weight totals for the sell form. Pure math, no fish-size-grade validation.

Retrieve a pond by its ID

get.description: Return the chronological fill/move/sell activity timeline for a pond, ordered by activity_date desc.

Return every production cycle (active + closed) for a pond, newest first, each with its P&L (totalCost, totalRevenue, feedCost, netResult). Feed cost for the active cycle is derived live; closed cycles use the value frozen at close.
Returns one sheet per month (fresh + pellet columns, deaths, tourist catch).

post.description: Record a fill activity for a pond. If the pond has no active cycle, creates one. Request: fishType, amount, activityDate; optional fishWeight, fishUnit, pricePerUnit.
Validate and compute fill summary (costs, stock impact) without persisting. For Review & Confirm flow.
Transfer fish from this pond to another. If destination is in maintenance, backend creates active_pond for it.
Validate and compute transfer summary (costs, stock impact) without persisting. For Review & Confirm flow.

parameters.description: toPondId, fishType, amount, activityDate, pricePerUnit, additionalCosts
parameters.name: body

post.description: Record a sell activity. If markToClose is true, close the active cycle and set pond to maintenance.
Validate and compute sell summary (revenue, items, stock impact) without persisting. For Review & Confirm flow.

parameters.name: search

put.description: Authenticated user changes their own password. Requires current password.
Update any user. Super-admin only. Cannot promote to SuperAdmin or modify an existing SuperAdmin.

delete.description: Soft-delete a user. Super-admin only. Cannot delete self or another super admin.

put.description: Reset another user's password. Super-admin only. Cannot reset a SuperAdmin.

clientId.description: when JWT has no clientId (e.g. super admin), required for create

fishWeight.description:
FishWeight (avg kg/fish) is required: fill cost = amount × fishWeight ×
pricePerUnit, so a missing weight would silently book a zero stock cost.

totalCost.description:
Cycle P&L for the currently-active cycle (nil when the pond has none).
TotalCost/TotalRevenue are the accumulated transactional figures;
FeedCost is derived live from daily logs + feed price history; NetResult
= TotalRevenue − TotalCost − FeedCost.

fishCount.description:
FishCount is required: the active pond tracks stock by head count, so every
sold line must state how many fish it removes to keep total_fish accurate.
